edition.title: This weekend on Keowee + Jocassee
edition.dek: Jazz on the Alley is done for the year, so the weekend shifts to the breweries and High Falls County Park's Día de los Muertos Festival Saturday — with live music at Keowee Brewing and Jocassee Valley Brewing all three nights.

events.title: First Friday Fish & Chips, then J. Stephens at Keowee Brewing
events.body: The brewery runs its First Friday fish & chips special all day, then J. Stephens takes the stage in the evening.
events.note: Free to attend · Fish & chips 11am–9pm, music 6:30–8:30pm · Keowee Brewing, 401 E. Main St., Seneca

events.title: Jocassee Valley Brewing: Dog Gone Boys + Simple Sammies
events.body: Live music from the Dog Gone Boys, with Simple Sammies' food truck out front for the evening.
events.note: Free · Open 9am–9pm, music 6:30pm · Jocassee Valley Brewing, Salem

events.title: Día de los Muertos Festival at High Falls County Park
events.body: Art, music, dancing, food, and family activities on the Lake Keowee shoreline at High Falls. Ticketed through Eventbrite — price wasn't listed when we checked, so confirm there.
events.note: 3–9pm · High Falls County Park, 671 High Falls Rd., Seneca · check Eventbrite for price

events.title: Saturday night, two breweries: Billy Bauer and Big Eyes Parker
events.body: Keowee Brewing has Billy Bauer playing downtown Seneca; across the water, Jocassee Valley Brewing has Big Eyes Parker with Buns & Bones' food truck out front.
events.note: Free · Both start 6:30pm · Keowee Brewing, 401 E. Main St., Seneca & Jocassee Valley Brewing, Salem

events.title: Jocassee Valley Brewing: Down Homesteaders
events.body: An afternoon set closes out the weekend, Farm to Fire Fermentery's food truck back for the day.
events.note: Free · Music at 4pm · open 12–7pm · Jocassee Valley Brewing, Salem

plan.title: Fish & chips at Keowee Brewing, then J. Stephens
plan.body: The First Friday special runs all day; music starts at 6:30. Good excuse to make it dinner.
plan.label: Find a spot to eat & drink →

plan.title: Get on the water before High Falls fills up for Día de los Muertos
plan.body: The festival runs 3–9pm at High Falls County Park. Launch early and have the lake to yourself in the morning.
plan.label: Find a ramp →

plan.title: Check the lake level before the Down Homesteaders' set
plan.body: Jocassee Valley Brewing's music starts at 4pm. See where Keowee and Jocassee stand before you head out for the afternoon.
plan.label: Check the lake level →
